entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Niijima-kun, what is going on here!?

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Apparently the damage done by this[n]so-called mafia has even reached our[n]student body!

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: I thought this absurdity was nothing but[n]a joke!

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Not only are there victims, there are even[n]rumors that some are involved with such[n]crimes...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: I've even received inquiries from their[n]guardians. Why is this happening?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Unfortunately, I do not have the answer[n]to that...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: This is the greatest disgrace in the[n]history of this academy... If it were[n]to be discovered...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: This is a vital issue for the student[n]council! Did I not ask you to resolve it!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm... doing the best I can.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: A-And I can trust you!? You must do[n]something about this at once!

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: You're the only one who is reliable[n]around here... Don't let me down...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: From what I've heard, even the other[n]students are starting to be dissatisfied[n]with you.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: At this rate, you and I will both lose our[n]roles at this school. Do you understand?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I do. Please, just give me a little more[n]time...
